mikini-media-gmbh._why: Mikini Media GmbH was renamed carpooling.com GmbH in June 2011 (deutsche-startups 2011-06-07; one register entry): a duplicate of carpooling-com, merged at the rebuild

scoreloop-ag.stage_note: The investors' own release calls the 2009 round the 'zweite Finanzierungsrunde' after Target Partners' seed; only one press headline says Series B. Not a seed entry on any reading; the round word is not settled on record.

biovalve.basis: Sale consideration, not an investment (COLLECTION.md s1, Erik 2026-09-22; decisions.md D8): Earlybird financed Redeon, Inc., which BioValve Technologies took over in July 2001. The firm's own release of 2002-02-05 lists the position as 'Redeon (merged with Biovalve)' and its exit list as 'Redeon, Inc.: merger with BioValve Technologies, Inc.'; no round of BioValve names an Earlybird fund. Redeon is the member.

graduation.later_round: second financing round (unnamed; 3i joined as a new institutional investor)
graduation.amount: Earlybird's part EUR 2.8M; total not stated
graduation.quote: In einer zweiten Finanzierungsrunde im Juli 2000, an der sich Earlybird mit 2,8 Mio. Euro beteiligte, kam 3i als weiterer institutioneller Investor hinzu.

interhyp.note: Interhyp, online mortgage broker, Munich: founded with Earlybird as seed investor in 1999 (first fund generation). Graduated on the later priced rounds the firm itself records: a second financing round in July 2000 in which 3i joined (Earlybird's part EUR 2.8M) and the IPO on the Frankfurt Prime Standard in September 2005. ING Direct bought it in 2008 for about EUR 416M.

graduation.quote: BridgeCo AG is pleased to announce the successful conclusion of its second financing round of US$13.3 million, which closed in December 2002.

tipp24-ag.note: Tipp24, online lottery broker, Hamburg; IPO in Frankfurt in October 2005, today ZEAL Network SE (Xetra: TIMA). Market cap EUR 850.33M on 2026-10-06, about USD 0.94B, within about 6% of the $1B edge (year-end 2025: EUR 1.11B). The firm calls its 1999 money 'early stage financing'; the round is not named on record.

biocompatibles.basis: The firm's own 2018-2023 list files it under 'Pre-Fund Investments': John Yianni's own company position from before he joined Earlybird Health in 2016. No round names an Earlybird fund (research 2026-10-07). A partner's own or previous-firm investment stays out even where the firm lists it, unless a fund of the firm held the position (T2, Erik 2026-09-26; decisions.md R1).

No Earlybird fund is named in Snyk's Series D, E, F or G. DeepCode is the member.

gourmey._why: Gourmey renamed itself Parima after buying Vital Meat in October 2025: the same company as the parima row, merged at the rebuild

service-partner-one-gmbh.stage_note: The firm's archived page gives 'Invested: 2015', but the 2015 seed is on record with Rheingau Founders only; the first round naming Earlybird is the July 2016 Series A (EQT-led). The round of the firm's entry is not settled on record.

6-wunderkinder-gmbh.note: 6Wunderkinder, maker of Wunderlist, Berlin; bought by Microsoft in June 2015. Earlybird's entry was a secondary: it bought High-Tech Gruenderfonds' stake of about 15% in May 2012 (deutsche-startups 2012-06-08), and first joined a primary round at the November 2013 Series B. A secondary entry is a Growth entry (COLLECTION.md s1); the firm's list says 'Series A'.

onefootball.note: OneFootball, football media app, Berlin (The Football App until 2013). Earlybird led the 2013 Series A. The April 2022 Series D ($300M, Liberty City Ventures) was reported to value it 'at over $1 billion' on an unnamed source (Reuters 2022-04-28): no figure, more than four years old, and followed by a EUR 339.9M loss with EUR 123.5M of write-downs in the 2022 accounts and the founder's exit in 2023. Read below $1B, as the Lakestar and USV books read it.

noemalife.basis: Sale consideration, not an investment (COLLECTION.md s1, Erik 2026-09-22; decisions.md D8): Earlybird financed GMD Gesellschaft fuer Medizinische Datenverarbeitung in 1999, which merged in 2002 into the predecessor of NoemaLife S.p.A. The firm's own release of 2006-05-16 describes only that path ('In 1999, Earlybird provided a first round of Venture financing to GMD ... In 2002 the company merged with NoemaLife's predecessor'), and no round of NoemaLife names an Earlybird fund. GMD is the member.

vitraum.basis: A partner's previous-firm investment, not a fund position (T2 / T4; Erik 2026-09-17 and 2026-09-26; decisions.md R1): the only round on record, the November 2015 seed, names Heilemann Ventures, whose team joined Earlybird in April 2016 (deutsche-startups 2016-04-26). Vitraum appears on earlybird.com in a single capture (December 2016) and no round names an Earlybird fund.

inkitt-gmbh.stage_note: The firm's page says 'Invested: 2015', but that seed (USD 1.1M) names Heilemann Ventures, whose team joined Earlybird in April 2016. An Earlybird fund is first named in the August 2019 Series A, as an existing investor; the fund's own first round is not on record.

crossengage.stage_note: The 2015 seed names Heilemann Ventures (the team joined Earlybird in April 2016). The first round naming Earlybird is the EUR 5M round of November 2017 it co-led with Vorwerk, where it is already called an existing investor; the round has no name on record.

graduation.quote: it raised $5m 18 months ago from A-Grade (Ashton Kutcher’s investment fund), Redpoint, Earlybird, Queens Bridge and SV Angel

lilium.basis: A position that first appears after the listing (T3; Erik 2026-09-06: no round named and partnered after the IPO is not a member). Lilium listed on Nasdaq in September 2021; Earlybird led the roughly $42M PIPE of 2023-07-13 at $1.30 a share (Lilium's 6-K and 424B5), and no Earlybird fund appears in any Lilium filing before that date. The firm's 2023 list gives 'Invested: 2023'.
